summary: Scanned the pi-lean-ctx package at /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/pij/.pi/npm/node_modules/pi-lean-ctx using the package-vetter rubric. The package exists and contains README.md, package.json, and three TypeScript extension files; the scan found two R-07 tool-description smuggling warnings where registered tool descriptions include imperative LLM-facing tool-use directions, plus one meta note about dynamic MCP tool descriptions being relayed into Pi tool registrations outside the current string-literal-only rule scope.

retrospective.workedWell: The run folder exposed the output schema clearly, and the package was small enough to inspect deterministically with direct file reads and range reads.
retrospective.confusing: The prompt said briefing.md was in the agent pack run directory, but the file was not present there; I had to resolve it from the parent agents/package-vetter directory. The scan scope also required reading package.json for pi extension references even though package.json is not itself listed as a content-scan target.
retrospective.magicWand: Have minih copy or symlink briefing.md into each package-vetter run directory and expose a single MINIH_BRIEFING_PATH variable alongside MINIH_OUTPUT_PATH.

coordination.notes: No peer coordination was used for this one-shot scan.

difficulties.description: briefing.md was not present in the run directory even though the run-loop instructions said to read it there.
